content: The Founder sits at the end of the table with a painted tin turned over in his hands, not looking up. 'I'll say it once so nobody tiptoes. The report is uncomfortable. I still believe in two things: the number on the tin and the marigold inside it. Everything else is on the table. Just don't bring me invented numbers. I didn't invent a germination rate for strangers, and I won't take one from you either.'
round_time: Opening, Day 1 of the workshop (late 2026, between Archive 001 and Archive 002)

content: Head of Product uncaps a marker and writes three rules under the title. 'Ground rules. One: facts come only from the seed document and the report, and anything marked UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN; you can propose answers, but say the word proposal. Two: every fix leaves this room with an owner, a rough cost and a real-world test. Three: we are a founder-led budget, so anything expensive gets flagged. We have nine pain points and a 30-day window before Archive 002. I'm chairing, and I'm going to cut people off.'
round_time: Opening, Day 1 of the workshop (late 2026, between Archive 001 and Archive 002)

decisions.text: Workshop ground rules adopted: UNKNOWNs stay unknown, proposals labelled, every fix needs owner + rough cost + real-world test, flag expensive items

content: User Research leans forward, tapping the printed report where the yellow warning box sits. 'Before anyone quotes 5 of 6 or 0 of 5 at me: those are 36 LLM personas and scripted marigold outcomes. The direction is a hypothesis worth testing. The magnitude is not something we know. If I hear a simulated figure used as a forecast, I'll stop the meeting.'
round_time: Opening, Day 1 of the workshop (late 2026, between Archive 001 and Archive 002)

content: Brand watches the Founder's thumb trace the painted 001 on the tin. They're wondering whether this room is about to turn Preserve into a FAQ page with a logo on it. Mystique got them 13 simulated buyers. Fixing every complaint might take away whatever made people stop scrolling in the first place.

content: The Designer slides three leftover tins and a folded tee from the packing bench to the middle of the table and opens one tin. It's empty: no card, no instructions, nothing printed inside the lid. They leave it open in front of everyone without saying anything.

content: The Plant Specialist takes a seed packet from the shelf, holds it up to the window and puts it on the table next to the empty tin. 'Exhibit A and Exhibit B. A seed, and nothing telling anyone what to do with it.'

content: Growth already has their phone out with the reel analytics open, one knee bouncing under the table. 'Can we time-box this? The single biggest blocker in that report is that nobody knows what Archive 002 is. Every week we don't announce, the audience cools. Fix the fundamentals, sure, but in parallel.'

content: Community keeps their tone warm and their eyes on the Founder. 'I'll be honest from minute one. The line in that report that keeps me up is a skeptic doing the maths on Rs 1,09,900 sitting with someone who has no face. We'll get to it, and I'm not going to drop it.'

content: CX reads straight from their notes. 'Round 35 of the simulation. A buyer posts a dead-seed count and says nobody in charge said sorry or what happens next. Our answer was message me. That isn't a policy. I want that sentence gone before Archive 002 opens.'

content: Ops stays at the packing bench, arms folded, counting the leftover tins under their breath. They don't say anything yet. They're waiting for the first person to promise a date.

content: Finance writes 'Rs 1,099 x 100 = Rs 1,09,900 gross' at the top of a fresh page and underlines 'gross' twice. Every generous idea in this room is going to come out of that one line, and nobody has told them the seed packet cost or the painting time yet.

content: Legal's face is a small tile on the laptop screen at the end of the table. 'One standing caveat so I don't have to repeat it every time: anything I say about preorder terms, refunds or consumer protection is a proposal. Verify it with a professional before it goes public. I'm here to keep what we promise accurate, not to tell you what the law is.'
